style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, warm underground light
motion_rule: EVERY window has its own big physical event: something huge crosses the frame or covers the lens. He never stands still while he talks. Lens blacked out eight times
camera_moves: macro at 0.0, chest level at 2.2, wide at 4.6, low at the floor at 8.0, wide at 9.4
character: a plump velvet mole, tiny eyes, huge pink shovel-paws, dusty; utterly serious, never blinks at the absurd
cast: the NEIGHBOUR MOLE, only from 8.8: identical calculator, sitting in a heap of ringing coins, chewing calmly
props: CALCULATOR: chunky cream plastic, BLANK buttons and BLANK screen. COINS: fat brass discs. EARTH: crumbling dark soil walls
prop_continuity: the calculator stays in his paws all clip and never lights up; coins come out of the earth, never out of it
environment: a round burrow, roots overhead, packed soil floor
lighting: warm bright light from a hole above, dust motes lit, crisp shadows, high exposure

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: calm businesslike male voice, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: speech 0.6-3.4 and 4.6-7.0 with one break; voiceless after 7.0, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable
audio.sfx: a dry plastic click on the button, one coin chime at 4.0, more joining and spreading, the whole burrow ringing by 8.0, an avalanche roar at 9.4

timeline.a: silent. The calculator is SHOVED into the lens filling the frame, blank buttons, blank screen, then whipped back into his paws as he lurches forward
he tosses the calculator paw to paw right at the lens, each toss blacking out the frame, roots swinging past his head
he strides straight at the camera until his dusty snout fills the frame, both shovel-paws swinging through the shot
silent. One huge paw slams onto the big blank button, the calculator bending under it, dust bursting off across the whole lens
silent. The calculator stays blank and dead. Behind him the EARTH WALL cracks and a brass coin punches out of the soil and flies past the lens, ringing
he wheels round to the wall, dust sheeting off his back across the frame, and two more coins burst out of the soil into the lens
he works along the wall slapping it with both paws, a clod flying off at the lens with every slap, coins punching out of the roof and rolling past the camera
silent from now on. He digs: earth flies STRAIGHT INTO THE LENS in great clods, filling the frame, the ringing multiplying behind it
silent. Coins burst from the roof and the floor at once and pour past the lens in a stream; he swats through them with both paws
silent. He rams his shoulder through the last wall, it bursts apart across the frame, behind it the NEIGHBOUR mole sits in a ringing heap of coins with an identical calculator, chewing
silent. Our mole jams that same blank button again at the lens; the roof gives way and coins avalanche over him and bury the frame

must_appear: the calculator blank and silent all clip, the first chime from the EARTH and not the device, coins bursting out of soil, roof and floor, earth into the lens, the NEIGHBOUR with the same calculator, our mole pressing that button again at the end
negative_prompt: digits, numbers, letters, cyrillic, a lit calculator screen, the calculator ringing or glowing, subtitles, watermark, night, dark scene, dim light, people, a second calculator before 8.8, slow motion, speed ramp, the mole standing still while he talks, a static wide at the end, any voice from him after 7.0, silence in the tail, drawn-out delivery, grain
